Package com.senzing.sdk.core.auto

Interface SzAutoEnvironment

All Superinterfaces:
SzEnvironment
All Known Implementing Classes:
SzAutoCoreEnvironment
public interface SzAutoEnvironment extends SzEnvironment
Provides an interface for the enhanced functionality provided by SzAutoCoreEnvironment so that the functionality may be proxied or otherwise implemented.

  • Method Details

    • getConcurrency

      int getConcurrency()
      Gets the concurrency with which this instance was initialized.

      The value returned will be zero (0) if the thread pool has been disabled, otherwise it will be the number of threads in the pool.

      Returns:
      The number of threads in the thread pool for the internal ExecutorService, or zero (0) if threading is disabled.

    • getMaxBasicRetries

      int getMaxBasicRetries()
      Gets the maximum number of basic retries that will be attempted when a Senzing Core SDK operation fails with an SzRetryableException.

      See SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Initializer.getMaxBasicRetries() for a description of how the maximum is applied.

      Returns:
      The maximum number of basic retries that will be attempted when a Senzing Core SDK operation fails with an SzRetryableException.

    • getConfigRefreshCount

      int getConfigRefreshCount()
      Gets the total number of times the configuration was automatically refreshed either periodically or due to an exception on a method annotated with SzConfigRetryable.

      NOTE: This does NOT include explicit calls to SzEnvironment.reinitialize(long).

      Returns:
      The total number of times the configuration was automatically refreshed

    • getConfigRefreshMode

      SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode getConfigRefreshMode()
      Gets the SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode describing how this instance will handle refreshing the configuration (or not refreshing it). The mode is set based on the value for the configuration refresh period provided to the SzAutoCoreEnvironment.Builder via SzAutoCoreEnvironment.AbstractBuilder.configRefreshPeriod(Duration).
      Returns:
      The SzAutoCoreEnvironment.RefreshMode describing how this instance will handle refreshing the configuration (or not).

    • submitTask

      <T> Future<T> submitTask(Callable<T> task)
      Performs the specified task using this instance's configured thread pool and internal ExecutorService via ExecutorService.submit(Callable) or directly executes the task in the calling thread if the thread pool has been disabled.

      This returned Future will provide the result of the task via Future.get() upon successful completion.

      NOTE: Any Senzing Core SDK calls made using this SzAutoEnvironment instance will also be run in the same thread with no additional context switching.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The return type of the task.
      Parameters:
      task - The Callable task to perform.
      Returns:
      A Future representing the result of the result of the task.

    • submitTask

      Future<?> submitTask(Runnable task)
      Performs the specified task using this instance's configured thread pool and internal ExecutorService via ExecutorService.submit(Runnable) or directly executes the task in the calling thread if the thread pool has been disabled.

      This returned Future will provide a null value via Future.get() upon successful completion.

      NOTE: Any Senzing Core SDK calls made using this SzAutoEnvironment instance will also be run in the same thread with no additional context switching.

      Parameters:
      task - The Runnable task to perform.
      Returns:
      A Future representing the result of the result of the task that will provide the value null upon successful completion.

    • submitTask

      <T> Future<T> submitTask(Runnable task, T result)
      Performs the specified task using this instance's configured thread pool and internal ExecutorService via ExecutorService.submit(Runnable, Object) or directly executes the task in the calling thread if the thread pool has been disabled.

      This returned Future will provide the specified result value via Future.get() upon successful completion.

      NOTE: Any Senzing Core SDK calls made using this SzAutoEnvironment instance will also be run in the same thread with no additional context switching.

      Type Parameters:
      T - The return type of the task.
      Parameters:
      task - The Callable task to perform.
      result - The result to return from the returned Future.
      Returns:
      A Future representing the result of the result of the task.
